Issue: one of my employee has left. I want to remove them from our hackerrank hiring account
Subject: Employee leaving the company
response:
To remove an employee from your HackerRank hiring account, you can deactivate their user account instead of deleting it. This preserves any historical data while removing their access.

Here’s how to deactivate a user:
1. Log in to your HackerRank for Work account and open the Admin Panel.
2. Click your profile icon in the Admin Panel and select **User Management**.
3. Locate the employee in the list and click the **ellipsis (⋯)** icon next to their name.
4. Choose **Deactivate User** and confirm by clicking **Deactivate** in the dialog box.

The user’s status will change to **Deactivated**, and they will no longer have access to your account.
